subject.title: fix #100368: mark undelivered message_tool_only finals in replay

question: After sibling-runner coverage is fixed, should OpenClaw adopt the hidden custom transcript message as the permanent model-visible representation of an original final that did not reach the source route?
rationale: The custom-message mechanism is technically supported, but it creates a durable delivery-specific session contract whose permanence requires session-owner intent.

options.title: Adopt the durable marker
options.body: Use the existing custom-message session seam consistently across both runner paths and preserve it through replay.

options.title: Project delivery state at read time
options.body: Keep transcript JSONL unchanged and synthesize the annotation only when constructing model context.

options.title: Rely on recovery only
options.body: Do not annotate history and accept that the original private turn remains indistinguishable from a delivered turn later.

recommendation.title: Adopt the durable marker
recommendation.body: Use the existing custom-message session seam consistently across both runner paths and preserve it through replay.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the canonical stranded-final recovery and authored its final lifecycle adjustment, giving the strongest available ownership signal for the cross-runner contract.
